title: Reject or Not?: A Benchmark for Voice Assistant Query Rejection in Smart Home Scenario and an Improved Method Based on LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of query rejection in smart home voice assistants. Although it includes 'Illegal Language' (e.g., abusive or politically sensitive content) as one of the 13 categories for rejection, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or deep ethical/moral frameworks.
